title: [Lean] Bound automatic-width counting by 12n+4
body:
## Completed chunk and coverage
This supplement connects PR64's fixed-direction potential bound to the actual automatic-width counter in #519. For every finite Boolean word of length n, including empty input, the existing ten-state, two-tape machine reaches its exact halted endpoint at some t <= 12*n+4. Input starts at its represented right blank and the counter tape starts pristine.

Finite coverage: exact receipt equality for arbitrary widths/starting words, pass.reads = CounterArithmetic.totalSteps true n bits + 2*n; hence pass.reads <= 6*n+2*width. With #519 allocation/controller overhead this yields 12*n+4. Counter width and stored value are n.
Conditional-interface coverage: the exact pinned CurrentMain.FixedTapeMachine and PR519 endpoint.
Full-theorem coverage: no full multiplication or kappa theorem, first-completion claim, compact-output normalization, input-preparation-to-counter composition, selected source caller, or Plan/Budget discharge. All-size compiler, chart/routing, prime-supply, precision/recovery, complex-symbolic and analytic-transfer obligations remain.

## Pins and explicit author-checked kappa
Base: 12a4934d15006e8c10f9b2264f13f8f341be802b.
Head: e7d6dc6e474f8690d72ef8b841290948028f66f3.
Author-checked conditional project kappa = 90446448750933/125000000000000000 = 0.000723571590007464, matched to the selected-result and retained PR279 certificate at that base. This is conditional project context, not a kappa theorem proved here. AUTHOR_CHECK.json records the author check.

## Reuse and attribution
Three source files only: five unchanged list definitions extracted from PR64; its original arithmetic declaration/proof bodies with explicit import/local registration/elaboration-control notices; and the receipt-transport bridge. PR64 already supplies the potential proof and richer generic counter/first-completion results; no new generic counter algorithm is claimed.
Nine unchanged dependency sources are hash-pinned to #488 at edd3102b415df5b9d6f633ac0a4dedcf69c58525, #511 at 79f7c03c7f820ab89955b75ef239cbaccc627e6e, and #519 at ffd3c48a80ba8b579dc300e785e387fe8acddfef. None is assumed merged. Later CI provenance changes do not alter those source blobs.
Apache-2.0, source attribution, modification notices and OpenAI-assistance disclosure are preserved. Duplicate comparison covered #64, #511 and #519; this adds the concrete receipt bridge and bound.

## Validation and reproduction
Lean 4.21.0, Mathlib 308445d7985027f538e281e18df29ca16ede2ba3; offline Python checker. README gives the exact command with three foundation worktrees and a fresh output directory. The checker validates 12 sources, 1,366 existing runtime source/object pairs and all 79 complete axiom probes. Only standard propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound occur.
Completed reproduction: 17.7186 compiler seconds, 0.00557 FIFO seconds, peak VM 3,074,072,576 bytes. Ten verified fresh outputs were retained after a public notice syntax error; an independently reviewed one-byte ordinary-comment fix and guarded two-root suffix completed the replay. REPLAY_SUMMARY preserves this sequence. Eleven objects match research; the public arithmetic copy has its own accepted object. No unchecked failure is counted as a pass.
One additive commit: 18 files, 24,180 additions, zero deletions, only research/lean-count-receipt-amortization. Most bytes are exact dependency evidence. No root files or scientific checks changed. Local kernel evidence is distinct from CI; this branch inherits the known joint-dual provenance issue pending separately authorized rollout of the repair tested on #511. Fork CI is not yet passed; upstream execution may require maintainer approval.
